answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a physical ablation sensor whose char depth, like strata in marble, encodes a unique thermal history that is costly to fake. Verifying agents cross-check this signature against a distributed quartz clock lattice, so a sybil cluster on one network island cannot replay a single re-entry profile across many identities. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
